name: BlueConic
description: BlueConic is a customer data platform for collecting, unifying, segmenting, governing, and activating first-party customer data across channels. Its REST API v2 exposes profiles, segments, interactions, and audit events through tenant-specific HTTPS endpoints and OAuth 2.0.
agentUseSummary: Add customer-owned OAuth 2.0 client credentials and bind one exact BlueConic tenant; agents can read only an identity-free aggregate segment count.

credentialRequirements.name: BLUECONIC_TENANT_NAME
credentialRequirements.label: BlueConic tenant name
credentialRequirements.helpText: Enter only the tenant label from www.{tenant}.blueconic.net; Relay binds requests to that exact official HTTPS host.

credentialRequirements.name: BLUECONIC_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: BlueConic OAuth client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Use a dedicated customer-owned client-credentials application whose scopes permit only the required segment read.

credentialRequirements.name: BLUECONIC_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: BlueConic OAuth client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Relay encrypts the matching secret and exchanges it only at the bound tenant's documented token endpoint.

capabilities.label: Read segment readiness summary
capabilities.description: Count segments for the exact bound tenant while excluding tenant identity, segment identity and definitions, membership, profiles, interactions, audit events, and customer data.

approvalRequired.label: Get BlueConic segment readiness summary
approvalRequired.description: Return only the aggregate segment count from the exact tenant's fixed REST API v2 segment-list endpoint.

blocked.label: Access segment identity, definition, or membership
blocked.description: Segment IDs, names, descriptions, rules, definitions, status, sizes, membership, creators, timestamps, and other segment fields remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access profiles, identities, interactions, or audit events
blocked.description: Profiles, visitors, identifiers, properties, PII, consent, interactions, events, channels, audit records, users, and raw customer data remain blocked.

blocked.label: Access activation, connections, or exports
blocked.description: Destinations, connections, campaigns, journeys, dialogues, content, recommendations, exports, imports, data feeds, and delivery state remain blocked.

blocked.label: Create, update, delete, or administer BlueConic
blocked.description: Profile or segment mutation, event posting, applications, users, roles, scopes, credentials, settings, webhooks, and administration remain blocked.

blocked.label: Use raw API or bulk access
blocked.description: Arbitrary tenants, origins, paths, methods, headers, queries, bodies, filters, pagination, polling, retries, SDKs, browser sessions, bulk, and exports remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: The aggregate segment count requires approval; identity, customer data, activation, writes, administration, raw APIs, and bulk remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same bounded count runs directly; exact tenant binding, short-lived token exchange, redaction, response cap, audits, and provider limits remain mandatory.

runtimeSupport.description: OpenClaw receives one fixed tenant-bound identity-free BlueConic segment-count wrapper.
Hermes receives the same fixed BlueConic wrapper.

providerSetup.blocker: BlueConic REST API v2 access requires an eligible tenant, a customer administrator-registered client-credentials application, narrowly configured scopes/run-as permissions, and live acceptance.
providerSetup.nextAction: A customer administrator confirms entitlement, registers a dedicated least-privilege client-credentials application in BlueConic, supplies the exact tenant label and credentials, and completes a live read-only acceptance check.

evidence.supports: BlueConic documents REST API v2 as an OpenAPI/OAuth 2.0 interface for profiles, segments, interactions, and audit events and describes application registration and authorization.

BlueConic documents trusted machine-to-machine client credentials, application scopes/run-as permissions, one-hour access tokens, POST /rest/v2/oauth/token, Bearer authorization, and GET /rest/v2/segments on the exact tenant host.
BlueConic documents REST API v2 as JSON-only, OpenAPI-compliant, gzip-oriented, and secured with OAuth 2.0.

securityNotes: Relay encrypts the tenant label, client ID, and client secret; it sends the credentials only as form fields to https://www.{bound-tenant}.blueconic.net/rest/v2/oauth/token.
Relay validates a single DNS-label tenant and constructs the official blueconic.net origin itself, preventing runtime origin or hostname selection.
Relay uses the short-lived bearer token only for the immediately following fixed GET /rest/v2/segments call and never returns or persists it.
Relay rejects redirects, waits at most 30 seconds per request, caps token and API responses at 1 MB, accepts no runtime input, and never paginates or retries automatically.
Output contains only the aggregate segment count; tenant identity, segment fields, membership, profiles, interactions, audit events, customer data, activation, and raw responses are excluded.
Provider setup, application/scopes/run-as configuration, credential capture, tenant confirmation, and live acceptance remain customer/external steps.
